title: Opening: address, date and introductions of the Pierce family
summary: Allen records at the Pensacola home on 6 May 1961 and gets names, ages and instruments of those present, including Ida's sister Billie, De De Pierce and the children.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We're recording today in Pensacola, Florida. What's the address here?
1410 or railroad. Either Tarragon or one.
Tarragon or railroad. I see. And today is May the one. I can't remember.
1961. May 6th, 1961. And let's get your name. Myrda Goodson. All right. And your what over here?
Willie Madison Goodson. Pierce. All right. And what's your name, Didi?
Joseph LaCroix Pierce. Mm-hmm. And they're better known as Didi. But and your what?
Rose Thomas. How do you spell it? R-O-Y-C-E. T-H-O-M-A-N.
Nice to meet you. And what do you play? I play a clarinet. I see. And how old are you? 14. You're 14. Can you fake? Yes, sir. You can fake and read both, huh? Can you read? Yes, sir.
Oh, well that's wonderful. My little boy sings now. Don't forget to put him down.

Where is that? Let me get Sammy Lee. Let me get Sammy. Sammy Lee, huh? That's right. Sammy Lee Thomas. Okay. Well now we'll just start asking personal questions right away. That's right. Are you older than Billy or younger?
